title: Star Class
tagline: Rocket School re-cut for P1 to JSS3 in sub-Saharan Africa: maths, English, Science, Reasoning, Geography and French, with prices in naira.
readinessNote: The worked example of a curriculum swap: the same game as Rocket School with another school in its data. 154 skills in one JSON list (Data/Curriculum); a fact bank needs no code, a new generated kind is one function. CLAUDE.md lists every place the classes, subjects, money and name live, for making your own edition.
buildYourOwn: Your own country's edition: its classes, subjects, question banks, money and explainers; new rocket parts.
controls: Mouse or touch; the keyboard for typed answers and the arrow keys in Make Ten Merge
